entities.name: Július Bielik
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Július Bielik is a Slovak former football player. He played for Sparta Prague in Czechoslovakia and Sanfrecce Hiroshima in Japan. He played for the Czechoslovakia national team 18 times and was a participant at the 1990 FIFA World Cup.
